lyrics:
[Intro: solo piano, soft and spacious]

[Verse 1: warm, quiet, piano only]
Taxi at the kerb at five, the house was still asleep
Gate nineteen, a paper cup, a lanyard and a beep
There's a drawing in my pocket of a dog that's mostly green
I'm thirty thousand feet above the best thing I have seen

[Chorus: band lifts in, slide guitar, stacked harmonies]
I come around once every night
A face on a screen in the kitchen light
Say goodnight, blow a kiss to the glass
I'm a satellite dad
Going over, going past
Look up, I'm the slow one, I'm the last

[Verse 2: warm, bass and brushed drums]
The minibar is humming and the curtains never close
I've a slide deck and a rental and a town that no one knows
I tell myself it's for them, and mostly that is true
But a year's a lot of bedtimes to be waving at a view

[Chorus: band, slide guitar, stacked harmonies]
I come around once every night
A face on a screen in the kitchen light
Say goodnight, blow a kiss to the glass
I'm a satellite dad
Going over, going past
Look up, I'm the slow one, I'm the last

[Bridge: synth swoops, acoustic guitar, voice higher]
And nobody tells you
That the signal isn't you
It's a picture of a person
Coming through

[Final Chorus: full band, voices wide, slide guitar soaring]
I come around once every night
A face on a screen in the kitchen light
Say goodnight, blow a kiss to the glass
I'm a satellite dad
Going over, going past
Look up, I'm the slow one, I'm the last

[Outro: voices repeating, band fading, a door opening]
I'm coming down
I'm coming down
I'm home
